name: message
description: One turn in a conversation: who said it, what was said, and for assistant turns the receipt of canvas changes it made. Render inside a list so the conversation has structure.

role.description: error is a system notice, such as a failed model call.

content.description: Plain text. Blank lines start a new paragraph.

author.description: Display name. Defaults to You, Assistant, or System by role.

from.description: The page the message is shown on, so an Undo in the receipt returns there.

changes.description: Canvas changes made during this turn, shown as a receipt under the text.

id.description: Block id the change applied to, when it still exists.

href.description: The page of the thing changed, so the receipt leads to it. Left out when the thing is gone.

activity.description: The activity entry of this change, given only while it can still be undone; the receipt then offers Undo.

links.description: Links to content created during this turn, shown under the text as inline citations.

id.description: Anchor id so the page can link to the latest message.

keyboard.does: reaches each change in the receipt that still exists, as a link to its page

wcag.notes: Author is text, not colour or alignment alone (1.4.1). Each message is an article with its author as the first line so screen readers can move between turns. The change receipt is a real list with a heading only screen readers hear.

machine.identify: Read data-role for who spoke (user, assistant, error) and data-actor for the provenance tone (human, assistant, system). The article text is the content; the .sw-message__changes list, if present, has one li per canvas change with data-action and data-target.
